scope: Committed production graph at the exact repository heads below. Test, docs, generated, vendor and build output are evidence roots, not production runtime.

rules.currentConsumers: Session-compatible identity, protobuf envelope, padding, onion/storage/group/config compatibility tests and adapters.
rules.prerequisite: DeepAccountId, Deep native envelope, reviewed pairwise/group crypto, native storage/RPC and replacement vectors are accepted and all consumers cut over atomically.
rules.impact: Signed/wire breaking change; removes Session protobuf, 05/03 identity prefixes, compatibility envelopes, Ed25519-to-X25519 identity coupling and legacy parser domains.
rules.evidenceToPort: Preserve adversarial bounds, canonical encoding, sodium vectors and parser fuzz cases as Deep-native negative/reference vectors.

rules.currentConsumers: Useful primitive-size constants, conversation/group/config state and reviewed Deep-native membership, Nearby and LoRa capabilities that still carry Session-shaped identity or compatibility fields.
rules.prerequisite: Split retained primitive constants from legacy policy, then replace identity/state fields with versioned DeepAccountId/device key references without weakening capability, replay or bounded-framing invariants.
rules.impact: Wire and signed-field version bump; capability semantics retained.
rules.evidenceToPort: P03C/P03D/P18A and membership-route golden, mutation, replay, maximum-frame and downgrade tests.

rules.prerequisite: Deep-native mailbox/storage transport is the sole production route and release graph has zero references.
rules.impact: Runtime endpoint and persistence transport removal; no migration or fallback.
rules.evidenceToPort: Retain failure, retry, cancellation, idempotency and privacy tests against the native transport.

rules.currentConsumers: Accounts, contacts, groups, messages, E2EE, push, calls, mailbox import, repositories and runtime state coupled to SessionId/DPE1/DMC1.
rules.prerequisite: Versioned Deep account/device identity, 24-word recovery, hybrid handshake/ratchet, native group state and atomic database reset/cutover.
rules.impact: Database schema, signed identity, wire envelope, push/call addressing and public application model change.
rules.evidenceToPort: Conversation/outbox/idempotency/mailbox/call/push/store crash and privacy suites; replace Session vectors with Deep golden vectors.

rules.currentConsumers: Onboarding, identity display/input, recovery, mailbox provisioning, background sync and view models exposing Session-shaped identifiers.
rules.prerequisite: Shared client Deep identity/store APIs are stable; perform one atomic UI/composition cutover and pre-production account reset.
rules.impact: UI validation, secure storage schema, recovery UX and composition root; no live dual stack.
rules.evidenceToPort: MAUI view-model, smoke, secure-store, recovery, background-sync and release-profile tests.

rules.currentConsumers: Session JSON-RPC storage and legacy onion peer endpoints.
rules.prerequisite: Deep-native node messaging/storage/onion API and route privacy model pass independent review and all devops/e2e callers cut over.
rules.impact: HTTP/RPC wire removal and node dependency graph reduction.
rules.evidenceToPort: Preserve bounded request, authentication, replay, cancellation, privacy and peer-failure tests for the new node API.

rules.currentConsumers: Router composition, endpoint policy, relay contacts and mailbox replica paths still typed or configured through Session compatibility boundaries.
rules.prerequisite: Deep-native node contracts and algorithm/version policy are frozen; keep reviewed mailbox/membership/capacity behavior byte-for-byte where unaffected.
rules.impact: Composition and endpoint contracts; Deep mailbox/continuity state remains retained.
rules.evidenceToPort: Node runtime, relay, mailbox, production ingress, capacity and privacy tests.

rules.currentConsumers: Call signaling lookup validates and stores Session-shaped identities.
rules.prerequisite: DeepAccountId and call-signal wire/database schema are frozen.
rules.impact: Database key and signed/public call-address boundary; mailbox continuity catalogs retained.
rules.evidenceToPort: Call signal authorization, expiry, collision, privacy and real-PostgreSQL tests.

rules.currentConsumers: Push envelope addressing and encryption coupled to Session identity/envelope assumptions.
rules.prerequisite: Deep push descriptor and device-key hierarchy are frozen and metadata-minimization review passes.
rules.impact: Push wire, provider payload and device-token association database.
rules.evidenceToPort: Provider size, encryption, replay, token rotation, privacy and canary tests.

rules.prerequisite: Equivalent Deep-native golden/corpus gates exist and the last compatibility baseline is tagged.
rules.impact: No production wire; delete from release gates after reference extraction.
rules.evidenceToPort: Keep hostile vectors in an isolated non-production legacy reference archive.

rules.prerequisite: Native mailbox/storage service and deployment topology pass local survival and rollback rehearsals.
rules.impact: Container topology, environment variables and operational endpoints.
rules.evidenceToPort: Local compose, restart, retention, backup/restore and privacy gates.

rules.currentConsumers: File, push, calls, ingress, smoke and survival automation still names or routes Session-compatible services.
rules.prerequisite: Each native replacement has immutable build inputs, secret boundaries, health, rollback and fail-closed release gates.
rules.impact: Local/production topology, service URLs, ingress routing, metrics and operational documentation.
rules.evidenceToPort: Survival compose, chaos, canary, rollback, metadata privacy and production-ingress suites.

rules.currentConsumers: Cross-repository Session endpoint and runtime assertions.

retainedBoundaries.invariant: Reviewed PMA/PMR authority chain, canonical signatures, expiry and role separation.
Reviewed mailbox capability bounds, audience separation and nonforgeable verified states.
Reviewed managed-ingress canonical framing and authenticated admission semantics.
Reviewed membership authority, topology and bounded verification semantics.
P04/P09C/P10B/D/D2/E/F route, selection, continuity, history and owner-control capabilities remain Deep-native.
Durable CAS/HMAC catalogs, PostgreSQL replay/fork fences and owner-control state are retained.
Native MAU2 mailbox transport behavior is retained while its external identity type is redesigned.
Deep-native mailbox replica, publication, capacity and availability behavior is retained.

capabilityGaps.capability: pairwise forward secrecy and post-compromise security
capabilityGaps.gate: Reviewed hybrid handshake plus ratchet; DPE1 cannot be renamed and shipped.
MLS or equivalently reviewed group-state construction with removal/rekey proof.
Versioned owner/device hierarchy, 24-word recovery, revoke and recovery tests.
Native signed contact/config state with replay/fork/downgrade rules.
Path diversity, endpoint hiding, padding/metadata and censorship-resistance claims independently reviewed.

cutoverOrder: Freeze and tag the last compatibility baseline; production release graph forbids new Session dependencies.
Specify DeepAccountId, 24-word recovery, role-separated key hierarchy, hybrid handshake/ratchet and version policy.
Implement Deep native wire/storage/onion and client state on a dark path with unmistakable magic and no downgrade negotiation.
Cut over protocol and node, then shared client and MAUI, then push/calls/file/devops/E2E as atomic consumer groups.
Perform a destructive pre-production account/database reset; never run live dual-read, dual-write or bidirectional translation.
Delete runtime compatibility packages and endpoints; retain only quarantined offline vectors until the external audit closes.
